invariants.text: Project.project_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Task.task_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Task.project_id must reference an existing Project.project_id
A task must belong to exactly one project, as specified by the project_id field.
The status of a task must be one of the defined task status values, such as 'pending', 'in progress', 'completed'.
The priority of a task must be one of the defined priority values, such as 'low', 'medium', 'high'.
When a project is deleted, all associated tasks must also be deleted.
A project must have at least one task to be considered active.
The title of a task must not be empty when creating or updating a task.
The title of a project must not be empty when creating a project.
Task status updates must be recorded in the updated_at field of the task record.
When a task is updated, its updated_at field must be set to the current timestamp.
A project's created_at field must be set to the current timestamp when a new project is created.
